meta.name: Toybox
meta.description: Design tokens of the Pocket Arcade Shell (every screen except the game board). Extracted from the Toybox HTML mockup; the written spec is handbook chapter 18 (design system toybox).
meta.units: Lengths in points (pt) = CSS px of the 390 x 844 mockup at 1x. Durations in ms. Angles in degrees; negative = counter-clockwise.
meta.colorFormat: Opaque colours are #RRGGBB (uppercase) exactly as in the HTML. Translucent colours keep the HTML rgba() string; a #RRGGBBAA twin (key suffix Hex) is derived and listed in derivedHex.

derivedHex.#1D1B3A8C: scrim light: rgba(29,27,58,.55) written as #RRGGBBAA (alpha x 255, rounded)
derivedHex.#1D1B3A24: line light: rgba(29,27,58,.14) written as #RRGGBBAA (alpha x 255, rounded)
derivedHex.#03020CB3: scrim dark: rgba(3,2,12,.7) written as #RRGGBBAA (alpha x 255, rounded)
derivedHex.#E4E0FF29: line dark: rgba(228,224,255,.16) written as #RRGGBBAA (alpha x 255, rounded)

chosen.type.body.latin.lineHeight: 1.32 from the .app CSS; the HTML notes say 1.3 (same 22 pt at 17 pt after rounding).
chosen.type.label.lineHeight: 1.25 / 1.45 from the .btn CSS; the notes give 1.3 for all Latin text.
chosen.radii.component.sticker/chip: 8 as drawn by .stk and .chip; the token card labels xs 6 "stickers, chips".
chosen.elevation.knob/iconButton: 2 and 4 from .tg i and .ibtn; the token card lists only 0/3/5/6/8.
chosen.motion.springs.release.mass: mass 1; the HTML gives damping 12, stiffness 420 only, and Reanimated 4.5.1 defaults mass to 4.
chosen.fonts.display.file: LilitaOne.ttf (renamed from LilitaOne-Regular.ttf) so file name = PostScript name, the handbook chapter 10 convention.
chosen.color.colorBlind: Identical to standard: the HTML sets colorBlind to "same paints; shapes carry meaning".
chosen.spacing.layout.blockGap: 14 and the 20 pt gutter are off the 4-pt scale; they are named layout constants.

fixed.note: Printed parts (stickers, flags, week tag, art tiles, gold icon tiles, logos, confetti, hazard strip) keep toy ink #1D1B3A and white in both themes.

art.note: How-to-play mock art (S13) only; each game owns its pictures.

mockOnly.note: Google UMP placeholder in S3; the real form is drawn by Google.

display.copyright: Copyright (c) 2011 Juan Montoreano (juan@remolacha.biz), with Reserved Font Names "Lilita One"

text.upstreamFile: Rubik[wght].ttf (variable, wght 300-900), instanced at wght=400 and wght=700

title.use: screen titles without a top bar, empty states, S12 state heads (t-title, mini-h)

number.use: stat values (.sv sets line-height 1.1 in both scripts)

heading.use: panel and pack headings, step text, reason line (t-heading)

gameName.note: Lilita One in every language (brand), isolated LTR

rowButtonDescription.color: textMuted on secondary, onPop on pop

optionName.face: text (own script: Rubik for en/de, Vazirmatn for fa/ckb)

selected.note: Chosen segment, chosen option card and an "on" toggle key sit pushed in: translateY = elevation, no shadow, no squash.

reduceMotion.pressIn: sink without squash; shadow swap instant
reduceMotion.starPop: all stars shown at once, 120 ms fade
reduceMotion.hop: static blocks plus the busy text

icons.note: Each glyph is a list of layers drawn in one colour. stroke = SVG stroke of that width (cap/join given); fill = filled with the given rule. The HTML draws them as SVG; handbook chapter 18 section 3.12 turns them into one nonzero path each.

edge.color: currentColor (starOff on tiles and rating rows, onPrimary on the current tile)
